Her angelic smile conceals the true contents of her heart, which remain a mystery.

lines.text: I will guide you to paradise, Your Grace.
Those deserving the blessing of paradise shall have it.
This is Eden's armor. Do you like it?
So long as we share a common goal, we can be together moving forward.
I will have plenty of use for you in the future, Your Grace.
Don't you look forward to life in paradise?
Why aren't you saying anything? You aren't leaving me here while you do something else, are you?
Go ahead if you have a mission to complete. I'll keep watch over you here.
Neither the Ark nor Eden... interesting. This place reminds me of you.
Is this place your own paradise? Intriguing.
Wings of Victory? Pfft. A group of weaklings converging to make something as useless as themselves.
You called me? My name is Dorothy, and I guide others to paradise, Your Grace.
To thank you, I will give you results.
Thank you for this.
I'm quite capable of leveling up in the Ark as well, I see.
Is this how you take care of Nikkes?
Are you trying to get my attention?
Your efforts will not go unnoticed.
Recently, my mind has been filled with you.
Fine, you have piqued my interest. Satisfied?
Shall I use you, or make you mine... I'm not so sure what I'll do.
If you want, I will join you, Your Grace.
Did you find it?
Very well, moving out.
Coming.
I'm here. There's no cause for concern.
I will show you what Eden is capable of.
This will be finished soon. You can rest for a moment.
Reloading.
This may take more time than I thought.
You are merely delaying the inevitable.
My turn.
Everything superfluous will be banished from paradise.
Time to finish this.
I wanted a challenge.
Who's next?
Hmm... Let's see.
Very good.
Haha.
Damn you...
My apologies. I no longer wish to expend any energy here.
I shall grant you victory, Your Grace.
Talking about the good old days never gets old.
Even today's meeting will one day become a treasured memory.
We've really come a long way, haven't we?

It was a glorious time.
We were all together, and that was more than enough.

Red Hood, Lilith.
Neither of you has met Pinne yet, have you? I'll introduce you.
Stay a bit longer. Have dessert. We have a lot of time.

Where did everyone go?
Get back before the tea gets cold.

It has been a while since we last met.
Tell me more about the others.
Sorry, but I have plans today.
It is about time for me to go to the party.

The sun is so lovely up on the surface.
It's a waste being underground on a day like today.

The sun is shining so wonderfully today.
Pinne, should we invite everyone to a tea party?
I must protect the others.

As long as I am with all of you,
I can become stronger.
Leave the battle to me.
Thank you. I shall put it to good use.
Oh my goodness... I think I'm going to cry.
Is there anything I can do for you?
We'll always be together, right?
Nothing lasts forever, but I get greedy sometimes.
True happiness must be something like this.
I shall take the lead.
Here.
Everyone, it's time to move.
Encounter.
If it's us, we can win.
Don't push yourselves too hard.
Let's do this. For the future.
Please cover me.
I'm reloading.
Sorry, I'll get back to it soon.
The light...
May this time last forever.
Everyone, come with me!
Neutralized.
Got you.
Did you see that?
Agh!
Urgh.
Hmph.
I must fall back. I will leave the rest to you all.

I am glad we wrapped this up before the tea got cold.
Would you not agree, Pinne?
I have no idea what Rapi was thinking, suggesting I become a pop star.

You want me to sing and dance? 
... Do you know how ridiculous you sound right now?
I've been told pop stars are meant to bring joy to people. Tell me, why should I be the one doing that?
Fan service? Well, I suppose I could wave at you like this.
You might be well-suited for the role of a pop star yourself, Your Grace. Just my opinion, of course.
If you wish to hear me sing, Your Grace, then I might consider it.
According to Rapi, pop stars have busy schedules. Do I really have the time to be waiting around like this?
Hm, hm-hmm ♬
You want my debut performance to be at the flower park? Don't be absurd. I've no intention of doing any such thing.
I'd rather no one see me dressed like this. Let's leave.
Have you seen Rapi? I'm not planning on causing trouble. I just want to know where she is.
*Sigh...* Shine forth in the twilight. Hello. I am Dorothy of Twilight.
I feel much lighter... but that doesn't mean I'm going to dance.
Not bad. I appreciate the support.
This is hardly the time for me to be playing dress-up. You realize that too, don't you?
A gift...? Shouldn't that be something a pop star gives her fans?
You aren't expecting anything in return, right? No song or dance?
If you insist, I will accept this for now.
A love story between a pop star and a fan is so terribly cliche... but I do think there's a reason such stories become cliche in the first place.
Lately, I have been experiencing a rather wide range of emotions thanks to you.
You're worried we might cause a scandal? That's a rather amusing thought.
I suppose it's time to get to work.
You called?
Yes, I'm coming.
How convenient. I was in a bad mood anyway.
This won't take long.
... What a pain.
Let's end this quickly.
Faster... Faster...
Agh...
Don't stare at me.
I'm ready.
This is going to hurt more than usual.
Time to wrap this up.
Is that all?
Next.
How boring.
Ugh...!
Ow.
What...?!
I told you this sort of thing doesn't suit me...
I'm about done humoring you in this outfit. Let's head back.
